I can't say. The tool returned INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for ASSET-J because the source coverage the asset needs (Hansen Global Forest Change, JRC GFC2020 and MGAP 2021) has not been prepared. No observation was made for the 2021-01-01 to 2025-12-31 period.

This means the result neither shows that tree-cover loss occurred nor that it didn't. It also supports no compliance conclusion, such as EUDR status.

To get an answer, the missing source coverage must be prepared for this asset and the analysis re-run. The asset's area is also not recorded, which you may want to confirm along with the boundary.
